[folded GR-14.9.25.4-L2.1 = §14.9.25.4 9) b) 1.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work/PB393.md landed. GR9b's space-fill recursion step 1 -- "If the data item to be space-filled is a dynamic-length elementary item, the length of the receiving operand is set to zero". The carrier's DynLeaf arm stores through 8.5.1.10.4's replace-with-no-padding rule, and a component that was carried EMPTY (or not carried at all) therefore lands as length zero, which is exactly what this step requires. The Z= leg of conformance:cases/14.9.25-MOVE/pb393_move_varlen_group reads FUNCTION LENGTH of the receiving dynamic-length item after a zero-length sending one and gets 0.

[folded GR-14.9.25.4-L2.2 = §14.9.25.4 9) b) 2.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work/PB393.md landed. GR9b's space-fill recursion step 2 -- "If the data item to be space filled is a dynamic-capacity table, it is space filled according to 14.6.9.4" -- and 14.6.9.4 is emphatic about WHICH way: "the current capacity of the dynamic table is unaffected, and each element of the dynamic table is space-filled". That is the OPPOSITE of recreating the table from an empty carried component, which is 14.6.9.2's rule for a sender that genuinely carried an empty table, and the two arrive as the same zero-length string -- so CobolVarGroup.HasDyn tells them apart and CobolDynTable.SpaceFillElements implements the 14.6.9.4 arm. The shape is reachable on conforming source through 8.5.1.12.2's last sentence, which admits a trailing dynamic-capacity table beyond the shorter group's last character "treated as if it corresponds to a space-filled fixed-length table": the X= leg of conformance:cases/14.6.9.2-Moving-a-table/pb393_move_varlen_table moves a fixed group with no table at all into a group whose trailing dynamic table holds two elements, and asserts the capacity is still 2 and both elements are spaces.

GR9b's space-fill recursion step 3 -- "All other character positions are filled with space characters" -- plus the sending-longer direction of the same rule, "the character positions that occupy the excess part are ignored by the operation".
